name: More than just Gold
source:
Vincent is on the run, after being able to reclaim the parts of the map that leads to the Magician's treasure. What was once thought to be a myth, now a potential reality of riches right in his grasp, if he can find it first, or the third part of the map which will help lead to the treasure! At the same time, a shady orgization lead by a moose chases after him, closing in with no way to possibly escape.

Unbeknownst to both parties, a random fox wandering the woods disrupts everyone's plans...

[From [url=https://hollow-soul-stories.itch.io/mtjg]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
文森特在夺回地图上通往魔术师宝藏的部分后开始逃亡。曾经被认为是一个神话的东西，现在已经成为他掌握中的潜在财富，如果他能先找到它，或者地图的第三部分将有助于找到宝藏！与此同时，一个以驼鹿为首的阴暗组织对他穷追不舍，逼近无路可逃。

双方都不知道，一只在树林里闲逛的狐狸打乱了所有人的计划……

[来自[url=https://hollow-soul-stories.itch.io/mtjg]Itch.io[/url]]
